justification: Inspected `jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/Configuration.java` and `jimfs/src/test/java/com/google/common/jimfs/ConfigurationTest.java`. `WindowsHolder` is only lines 180-191 in `Configuration.java` and contains a single `private static final Configuration WINDOWS` constant with no methods and no separate behavior; it just prebuilds the Windows default used by `Configuration.windows()`. The tests in `ConfigurationTest.java` only verify that fixed preset, which supports that this nested class is a small initialization holder rather than an insufficiently modular class.
